fit_reason: Private-owner listing for a whole 14 ft Lund aluminum boat with trailer, which we can clean and polish.
findings: Dirt and scuffed grime streaks on the floor of the bow section inside the hull
Debris and grime in the bottom of the hull near the stern
Painted red topside looks somewhat dull and faded in the side profile shot
Bare aluminum gunwale rail and stern corners look dull and weathered

message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Lund 14 and trailer. The inside floor of the hull has some dirt streaking up front, and the red paint along the side looks a little dull in the photos. We do mobile pre-sale cleanups that include cleaning out the hull, buffing the paint and brightening the aluminum rails, and we can come to you. Would you like a quote?
